<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Demon Realm Villagers''' are the residents of the demon villages of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]], dressed in Demon Realm outfits. About '''40%''' of them are '''bug traders''' who sell Medi-Bugs.
</translate>

<translate>
== Where to find them == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Demon villages generate on the Third Demon World: a plaza surrounded by 3–5 adobe houses, 1–2 farms, adobe-brick paths and lantern posts. Each house has 1–2 villagers. Every village also has a [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]] on its plaza.
</translate>

<translate>
== Medi-Bug trades == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
A bug trader sells 2–3 of these offers for emeralds. The other villagers don't trade.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:11--> Item</translate> !! <translate><!--T:12--> Effect when eaten</translate> !! <translate><!--T:13--> Cost</translate> !! <translate><!--T:14--> Uses</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:15--> Medi-Bug (Ant)</translate> || <translate><!--T:16--> Restores 85% of your health, ki and stamina. It has its own cooldown, as long as the Senzu Bean's.</translate> || <translate><!--T:17--> 8 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate><!--T:18--> Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate> || <translate><!--T:19--> Right-click to split it into two identical Medi-Bug (Beetle). Two players who eat beetles with the same ID within 30 seconds fuse.</translate> || <translate><!--T:20--> 16 Emeralds</translate> || 2
|-
| <translate><!--T:21--> Medi-Bug (Rhino)</translate> || <translate><!--T:22--> Medi-Bug Shell for 45 seconds: you take 30% less damage.</translate> || <translate><!--T:23--> 6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate><!--T:24--> Medi-Bug (Worm)</translate> || <translate><!--T:25--> Mastery Gain II for 5 minutes: 50% more form mastery.</translate> || <translate><!--T:26--> 6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|}

<translate>
<!--T:27-->
Trades restock once per in-game day when you trade with the villager. The beetle fusion is explained on [[Special:MyLanguage/Medi-Bug Beetles|Medi-Bug Beetles]]. Besides the bug traders, Bulma's repeatable '''Medi-Bug Market''' sidequest sells a batch of Medi-Bugs (a Beetle pair included) for emeralds and gold ingots, once an hour.
</translate>

{{Note|type=warning|title=<translate><!--T:28--> Alignment</translate>|<translate><!--T:29--> Killing a Demon Realm Villager or the Time Patroller lowers your alignment.</translate>}}

{{See also|Alignment|Medi-Bug Beetles|Effects}}
